title: Eye In The Sky
required_registry_note_ru: Alan Parsons остается современным контрольным примером: официальный сайт The Alan Parsons Project связывает концепцию Eye in the Sky с системами верований, идеей наблюдения сверху, а также военным и surveillance-употреблением выражения. Официальный текст не называет золотой знак на обложке прямо Eye of Horus, поэтому идентификация обложки как Eye of Horus / Wedjat остается высокоуверенной визуальной и вторично-источниковой классификацией. Новая древнеегипетская находка добавляется только как отдельный сравнительный слой: на Horus stelae / Metternich tradition Eye of Horus участвует в защите того, кто находится на воде. Это не доказывает историческую передачу значения к альбому 1982 года.

established: The album concept is related to belief systems, including religious, political and gambling belief.
The concept invokes the universal idea that someone is looking down on us.
The expression is also used in military and surveillance contexts.
Eric Woolfson recalled a Tropicana Hotel and Casino surveillance system called the eye in the sky.
Original album sleeve design is credited to Hipgnosis / APB / Colin Chambers.

cover_symbol_classification.meaning: A documented modern recontextualization of a Wedjat/Eye-of-Horus visual in a work whose official concept centers belief, observation, being watched from above, and surveillance.
cover_symbol_classification.not_established: The official album page does not establish that the cover glyph was textually named Eye of Horus by the band or designers in the retrieved source.

metternich_incantation_5.subject_semantics: The ritual subject on water is identified with Osiris; this is ritual identification, not a claim about a literal historical person travelling physically with gods.
metternich_incantation_5.wedjat_role: The Eye of Horus is with/on the subject on water and functions inside the protection formula against beings of the water.
metternich_incantation_5.ra_role: Ra participates as an active protective/authoritative divine node; the formula includes sealing/blocking hostile mouths/faces in the aquatic danger context.
metternich_incantation_5.highest_claim: The ancient witness supplies a securely distinct function for the Eye of Horus: protective accompaniment in an aquatic danger ritual.

functional_contrast_with_album.interpretation: The contrast is symbolically useful: the same broad eye visual family can be discussed as protective presence versus observing/control imagery. No direct historical lineage between the ancient ritual and the 1982 album is established.

horus_hands_bridge.established: BD113 / Coffin Text 158 has Ra dispatch Sobek, lord of the marsh, in a search that explicitly culminates in recovery of the hands/arms of Horus near/in the water setting.
horus_hands_bridge.interpretive_resonance: The existing user-authored line BE_THE_HAND_THAT_LIFTS_NOT_THE_EYE_THAT_WATCHES now has a separate ancient comparison in which the Eye protects and Horus's hands are recovered. This resonance is modern and personal; it is not ancient prophecy, authorial intent, or causal transmission.

highest_admissible_claim: Eye in the Sky remains a documented modern cultural junction where a Wedjat/Eye-of-Horus visual is paired with themes of belief, observation and surveillance, while Hawkar/JANUS preserve an explicitly support-not-control response. A newly linked but historically separate ancient layer shows the Eye of Horus functioning in aquatic protection on the Horus stelae, and BD113/CT158 separately shows Ra dispatching Sobek in the recovery of Horus's hands/arms. These findings justify a new body-part-restoration search and create a symbolic protection-versus-surveillance comparison, but they do not establish direct ancient-to-modern lineage or a complete Horus reconstruction.
